rules.title: Cleartext HTTP URL
rules.message: Cleartext endpoint `{match}` can expose network traffic to interception or modification.
rules.remediation: Replace the endpoint with HTTPS. If HTTP is required for local development, put it in a debug-only configuration and document the exception.

rules.title: Potential hardcoded secret
rules.remediation: Move secrets to a secure runtime mechanism and rotate exposed credentials.

rules.title: Logging call requires review
rules.message: Production logging call `{match}` may expose sensitive data or create unnecessary release noise.
rules.remediation: Remove the log, redact sensitive values, or guard it behind a debug-only build configuration.

rules.title: Potential unused local variable
rules.message: `{name}` is assigned but is not referenced later in this file.
rules.remediation: Remove it, use it, or suppress this finding when a framework accesses it indirectly.

rules.title: Exposed mutable Kotlin property
rules.message: A mutable property has no private visibility modifier.
rules.remediation: Prefer private state with an immutable public view.

rules.title: WebView JavaScript enabled
rules.message: JavaScript execution increases WebView attack surface.
rules.remediation: Enable it only for trusted content and restrict navigation and bridges.

rules.title: Custom TLS validation requires review
rules.message: Custom certificate or hostname validation can disable TLS protections.
rules.remediation: Use platform TLS validation unless a documented pinning design requires customization.

rules.title: WebView universal file URL access enabled
rules.message: WebView universal access from file URLs can let local content reach arbitrary web origins.
rules.remediation: Remove setAllowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs(true). If a legacy use case requires it, isolate the WebView, load only trusted content, and document the exception.

rules.title: WebView JavaScript bridge requires review
rules.message: A JavaScript bridge exposes native application methods to WebView content.
rules.remediation: Expose only a minimal, annotated bridge to trusted content and do not load untrusted URLs in the same WebView.

rules.title: Exported Android component requires review
rules.message: An exported component may be callable by other applications.
rules.remediation: Set android:exported to false unless external access is required; otherwise protect the component with an appropriate permission and validate all input.

rules.title: Android backup enabled requires review
rules.message: Application backup can copy data to user-controlled or cloud-backed storage.
rules.remediation: Set android:allowBackup to false for apps handling sensitive data, or configure backup rules to exclude credentials and private records.

rules.title: Debuggable application
rules.message: Application declares android:{attribute}=true; review the intended build variant.
rules.remediation: Confirm the release merged manifest sets android:debuggable to false.

rules.title: Cleartext traffic opt-in
rules.message: Application declares android:{attribute}=true; review the intended build variant.
rules.remediation: Review network security configuration and disable unnecessary cleartext traffic.

rules.title: Test-only application
rules.message: Application declares android:{attribute}=true; review the intended build variant.
rules.remediation: Remove android:testOnly from production manifests; keep it only in test builds.
